friendsMetaDescription: Your friends list, requests, and a quick way to start chatting.
friendsSubtitle: Your contacts and requests, all in one place.
requestsLede: Accept incoming requests and keep an eye on the ones you've sent. Accepted friends will show up under “Friends”.
signInToSeeRequests: Sign in to see friend requests and send new ones.
loadRequestsErrorDescription: Check your connection and try again.
noIncomingDescription: When someone wants to add you as a friend, their request will appear here.
noOutgoingDescription: Send a request by profile ID — it'll appear here and wait for a reply.
acceptNotFound: Request not found — it may have already been handled.
acceptForbidden: This request wasn't addressed to you.
addFriendDescription: Send a request by profile ID. You can copy the ID from the user's profile page.
invalidProfileId: Enter a valid profile ID (24 characters).
requestSentDescription: Wait for the user to accept it.
requestExists: A request already exists, or you're already friends.
cannotSendToUser: You can't send a request to this user.
sendRequestFailed: Couldn't send the request. Try again later.
loadDataError: Couldn't load the data. Please try again.
signInRequiredDescription: Sign in to your account to continue.
